answer: Deposits are visible in cipher, and sonnet reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 121 aliases, and each one needs its own funded kernel account. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 15 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
